pageDescription: Measures the space folders and files take on the chosen drive. It reads names and sizes only and changes nothing.
emptyStateDescription: Choose a drive and start the analysis.
checkFoldersDetail: Size of each folder for three levels; deeper levels are added to the folder that holds them.
checkTypesDetail: Space per extension, counted down to four folder levels when you open the File types view.
checkSkippedDetail: File contents are never opened. Folders without read permission are skipped and left out of the totals.
failedToAnalyzeDescMakeAccessible: Check that the drive is connected and readable.
failedToAnalyzeErrorWindows: Drive {{drive}}: was not analyzed. Check that it is connected and readable.
failedToAnalyzeErrorOther: {{drive}} was not analyzed. Check that it is connected and readable.
failedToScanFileTypesWindows: File types on drive {{drive}}: were not counted.
failedToScanFileTypesOther: File types on {{drive}} were not counted.
fileTypesEmptyDescription: Counting reads file names and sizes down to four folder levels.
fileTypesFacts: Largest: {{extension}}, {{size}} · counted down to four folder levels
repairDescription: Runs DISM and SFC, which can replace damaged system files, and CHKDSK, which checks the file system of drive C:. Administrator rights are required and each check can take several minutes.
repairWindowsOnlyDescription: DISM, SFC and CHKDSK are Windows tools and are not available on this system.
repairOrderNote: Run DISM first, then SFC: SFC replaces damaged files with the copies in the component store, which DISM checks and repairs.
dismCardDescription: Checks the Windows component store and repairs it with files from Windows Update. An internet connection is needed.
sfcCardDescription: Checks the protected system files and replaces damaged or missing ones with the copies in the component store.
chkdskCardDescription: Checks the file system of drive C: while it is in use. Windows can fix some errors right away; the others are reported.
restartRecommended: Windows asks for a restart to complete the repairs.

repairResult.needsAdmin: Administrator rights are needed to run {{tool}}: restart SuperSonicCleaner as administrator.
repairResult.exitCode: {{tool}} exited with code {{code}}: the details are in the log.
repairResult.sfcClean: No integrity violations in the system files.
repairResult.sfcRepaired: Damaged system files were found and repaired.
repairResult.sfcUnrepairable: Damaged files were found that SFC could not repair: run DISM, then SFC again.
repairResult.dismClean: No corruption in the component store.
repairResult.chkdskCorrected: File system errors were found and corrected.
repairResult.chkdskNoAction: Check finished: nothing else is needed.
repairResult.chkdskCleanup: Check finished; CHKDSK performed internal disk cleanup.

maintenanceDescription: Run TRIM on SSDs to keep write performance and lifespan healthy.
trimInfoBody: TRIM tells your SSD which blocks are no longer in use so it can erase them ahead of time. The OS already does this on a schedule — running it manually only helps when that schedule has lagged. HDDs do not need TRIM.
trimEmptyNoDrives: Couldn't enumerate any drives on this system.
trimEmptyFiltered: No drives match the current filter.
trimConfirmDescription_one: TRIM will run on {{count}} selected drive. This requires administrator privileges and may briefly slow disk I/O.
trimConfirmDescription_other: TRIM will run on {{count}} selected drives. This requires administrator privileges and may briefly slow disk I/O.
adminRequiredTrimDesc: Relaunch SuperSonicCleaner as administrator to run TRIM.
trimThrottledToast_one: {{count}} drive was trimmed less than 24 hours ago — skipped
trimThrottledToast_other: {{count}} drives were trimmed less than 24 hours ago — skipped

storage.title: Storage History
storage.description: Track local folder growth and compare storage snapshots
storage.privacy: Snapshots contain folder names and size metadata only, stored locally for up to 90 days within a 250 MB budget. Global exclusions apply. Logical sizes count each file path; links, other mounted volumes and SuperSonicCleaner's own data are excluded. No file contents are read or uploaded.
storage.capturing: Capturing metadata since {{time}}. You can leave this page.
storage.capturingOther: Capturing metadata for {{folder}} since {{time}}. Choose that folder to review its history.
storage.projectionValue: Around {{days}} days remaining at {{growth}} of growth per day.
storage.projectionRange: Approximate model range: {{min}} to {{max}} days, based on {{count}} daily observations.
storage.noProjection: A forecast needs at least seven comparable daily observations spanning seven days and a stable positive growth trend.
storage.projectionCaution: This estimates the whole volume from free-space measurements. Other applications and folders affect it. The range describes model fit, not a guarantee or proof of what caused growth.
storage.empty: Capture a baseline to begin. Incomplete or unavailable scans are kept with their status.
storage.compareHint: Choose an earlier Before and a later After snapshot. Only complete snapshots with the same volume, folder and exclusions can be compared.
storage.overlap: Rows include parent and child folders; do not add their totals together. Added/removed paths may represent moves or renames. Folder detail is retained for three levels; sizes include deeper files.
storage.noChanges: No folder changes in this comparison.
storage.deleteScopeConfirm: Stop automatic snapshots and delete this folder's local snapshot history? The actual folder and files will not be changed.
storage.deleteConfirm: Delete this local snapshot? Comparisons using it will no longer be available. Actual files are not affected.
storage.daily: Capture daily while SuperSonicCleaner is running
storage.dailyHint: Checks every ten minutes. Waits for AC power, two minutes of idle time and Game Mode to finish. At most one daily attempt per folder; offline attempts are recorded. Alerts are limited to once per folder per day and respect completion notifications.
storage.growthAlert: Growth alert (GiB since previous snapshot; blank disables)

reason.limit: Stopped at the scan limit; deeper folders may be missing
reason.changed: The folder or volume changed during the scan
reason.inaccessible: Some folders could not be read
reason.excluded: The folder is covered by a global exclusion
reason.cancelled: The capture was cancelled before it finished
reason.unavailable: The folder became unavailable during the scan

comparisonReason.incomplete: Partial, cancelled or unavailable snapshots cannot support a reliable growth comparison.
comparisonReason.scope: The volume, folder, exclusions or measurement policy differ.
comparisonReason.order: Choose an After snapshot taken later than Before.

storage.emptyDescription: Choose a folder, capture a baseline, then take another snapshot to see what grew. Your files stay untouched.
